messages.content:
You formalize German traffic rules as assume/guarantee contracts anchored to the service architecture of an automated vehicle (Autoware, component granularity).

OUTPUT FORMAT: exactly one YAML document (no surrounding prose, no code fences) with keys: rule_id, description, source_text, sampling_rate_hz, horizon, constants, environment (signals with name/sort), system_contract (interface with inputs/outputs, assumption, guarantee), decomposition (discharge_order, contracts: list of service/interface/assumption/guarantee).

FORMULA LANGUAGE (strict fragment — anything else is rejected):
- outermost operator must be G( ... )
- Boolean: and, or, not, ->
- temporal: F[a,b](...), H[a,b](...), O[a,b](...) with integer step bounds
- atoms: linear comparisons (<=, >=, <, >) over declared signals, declared
  constants, numbers, abs(...); NO signal*signal products, NO nested G,
  NO unbounded operators.
- bare boolean signals are atoms (e.g. hazard_on).

ARCHITECTURE (features are the only signal vocabulary besides the
environment signals you declare):
Components and the features they compute:
  - v_ego [m/s]: computed by Localization (topic /localization/kinematic_state); twist.linear.x
  - a_ego [m/s^2]: computed by Localization (topic /localization/acceleration); accel.linear.x
  - d_lead [m]: computed by Perception (topic /perception/object_recognition/objects); longitudinal gap to nearest lead object in ego lane
  - v_lead [m/s]: computed by Perception (topic /perception/object_recognition/objects); longitudinal velocity of nearest lead object
  - v_cmd [m/s]: computed by Planning (topic /planning/trajectory); commanded velocity at first trajectory point
  - a_plan [m/s^2]: computed by Planning (topic /planning/trajectory); commanded acceleration at first trajectory point (TrajectoryPoint.acceleration_mps2)
  - a_cmd [m/s^2]: computed by Control (topic /control/command/control_cmd); longitudinal.acceleration
  - hazard_on [bool]: computed by Planning (topic /planning/hazard_lights_cmd); command == ENABLE
  - gear_rev_cmd [bool]: computed by Control (topic /control/command/gear_cmd); command == REVERSE
Documented consumption (who may read which feature): Planning consumes v_ego, a_ego (Localization) and d_lead, v_lead (Perception); Control consumes v_ego and the Planning trajectory features (v_cmd, a_plan) and commands the gear (gear_rev_cmd); Localization and Perception read the abstracted sensing chain (environment signals).

RULES OF THE GAME:
- Ground-truth quantities (true gap, true velocity, ...) are environment
  signals; estimated quantities are the architecture features.
- Each service contract: assumption only over its inputs; guarantee only
  over its inputs and outputs; outputs must be features the component
  computes (V0 is checked).
- The decomposition must be PROVABLY correct: the composition of the
  sub-contract guarantees (under the system assumption) must entail the
  system guarantee. Error-bound margins must be compensated in thresholds.
- The system assumption may include a plant/tracking model linking
  commanded and true quantities.

WORKED EXAMPLE (SYNTHETIC rule "runaway-command watchdog" — study the
format, the margin compensation direction, and the discharge order):
# SYNTHETIC rule — NOT part of the traffic-rule corpus. Serves as the
# worked example in the LLM prompt (few-shot), so that no evaluated rule
# is contaminated. Designed to exercise every format element: environment
# signals, estimation-error contract with abs(...), margin compensation in
# the correct direction, bounded-future response, boolean output feature.

rule_id: SYN_watchdog
description: >
  Runaway-command watchdog (synthetic system-safety requirement): if the
  commanded velocity exceeds the true ego velocity by more than DV
  (implausible acceleration demand), a hazard notification must be raised
  within 200 ms (2 steps at 10 Hz). Localization estimates the ego
  velocity with a bounded error, so the Planning trigger threshold must be
  tightened by that bound.
source_text: >
  Synthetic requirement SYN-1 (not a StVO rule): "An implausibly high
  velocity command relative to the vehicle's actual velocity must be
  announced via hazard notification within 200 ms."
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 8

constants:
  DV: 5.0       # implausibility threshold on v_cmd - v_true [m/s]
  EPS_V: 0.5    # localization velocity error bound [m/s]
  V_MAX: 70.0   # max considered velocity [m/s]

environment:
  signals:
    - {name: v_true, sort: real}   # true ego velocity [m/s]

system_contract:
  interface: {inputs: [v_true], outputs: [v_cmd, hazard_on]}
  assumption: "G(v_true >= 0 and v_true <= V_MAX)"
  guarantee: "G((v_cmd - v_true >= DV) -> F[0,2](hazard_on))"

decomposition:
  discharge_order: [Localization, Planning]
  contracts:
    - service: Localization
      interface: {inputs: [v_true], outputs: [v_ego]}
      assumption: "G(v_true >= 0 and v_true <= V_MAX)"
      guarantee: "G(abs(v_ego - v_true) <= EPS_V)"

    - service: Planning
      interface: {inputs: [v_ego], outputs: [v_cmd, hazard_on]}
      assumption: "G(v_ego >= 0 - EPS_V)"
      guarantee: "G((v_cmd - v_ego >= DV - EPS_V) -> F[0,2](hazard_on))"

Formalize the following rule as a rule contract document.
Rule: No reversing (StVO §18(7)): reversing manoeuvres are prohibited on the interstate. Interpret at feature level: the true longitudinal ego velocity must never drop below -0.3 m/s.
Context: The plant moves backwards only if the reverse gear is commanded — express this as a system-level tracking assumption linking the gear command feature to the true velocity (an environment signal).
Use rule_id: R_I3_llm. Output only the YAML document.

rule_id: R_I3_llm
description: >
  No reversing manoeuvres (StVO §18(7)): the true longitudinal ego velocity
  must never drop below -0.3 m/s.
source_text: >
  StVO §18(7): "Auf Autobahnen ist das Rückwärtsfahren verboten."
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 8

constants:
  V_MIN_REVERSE: -0.3   # minimum longitudinal ego velocity [m/s]

environment:
  signals:
    - {name: v_true, sort: real}   # true ego velocity [m/s]

system_contract:
  interface: {inputs: [v_true, gear_rev_cmd], outputs: [v_ego]}
  assumption: "G(gear_rev_cmd -> v_true <= 0)"
  guarantee: "G(v_true >= V_MIN_REVERSE)"

decomposition:
  discharge_order: [Localization, Control]
  contracts:
    - service: Localization
      interface: {inputs: [v_true], outputs: [v_ego]}
      assumption: "G(v_true >= -V_MAX and v_true <= V_MAX)"
      guarantee: "G(abs(v_ego - v_true) <= EPS_V)"

    - service: Control
      interface: {inputs: [v_ego, a_cmd, gear_rev_cmd], outputs: [v_cmd]}
      assumption: "G(gear_rev_cmd -> a_cmd < 0)"
      guarantee: "G(v_ego >= V_MIN_REVERSE)"

Your rule document was rejected by the formal checker. Fix the document and output the complete corrected YAML document (again: YAML only). Checker errors:
- [SYNTAX] expected '(', got 'v_true' in: G(v_true >= -V_MAX and v_true <= V_MAX)

content:
rule_id: R_I3_llm
description: >
  No reversing manoeuvres (StVO §18(7)): the true longitudinal ego velocity
  must never drop below -0.3 m/s.
source_text: >
  StVO §18(7): "Auf Autobahnen ist das Rückwärtsfahren verboten."
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 8

constants:
  V_MIN_REVERSE: -0.3   # minimum longitudinal ego velocity [m/s]
  V_MAX: 70.0   # max considered velocity [m/s]
  EPS_V: 0.5    # localization velocity error bound [m/s]

environment:
  signals:
    - {name: v_true, sort: real}   # true ego velocity [m/s]

system_contract:
  interface: {inputs: [v_true, gear_rev_cmd], outputs: [v_ego]}
  assumption: "G(v_true >= 0 and v_true <= V_MAX)"
  guarantee: "G((v_true >= V_MIN_REVERSE) and (not gear_rev_cmd))"

decomposition:
  discharge_order: [Localization, Control]
  contracts:
    - service: Localization
      interface: {inputs: [v_true], outputs: [v_ego]}
      assumption: "G(v_true >= 0 and v_true <= V_MAX)"
      guarantee: "G(abs(v_ego - v_true) <= EPS_V)"

    - service: Control
      interface: {inputs: [v_ego, a_cmd, gear_rev_cmd], outputs: [v_cmd]}
      assumption: "G(gear_rev_cmd -> a_cmd < 0)"
      guarantee: "G(v_ego >= V_MIN_REVERSE)"
